scientific_integrity: Analytic universal proof with exact symbolic and rational checks; no independent review or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Two-state finite Markov generators with positive rates, constant step and one backward-Euler start only; all-step criterion does not imply arbitrary-history or higher-state positivity. Historical publication priority is provisional.
title: A sharp rate-imbalance frontier for all-step BDF2 positivity on two-state Markov chains
